description.p: Lorapok Instar is a systems-grade multi-account workspace engineered for Linux and Ubuntu desktops. Unlike sluggish web wrapper applications, Instar enforces hardware-accelerated Wayland compositing, V8 bytecode caching, SQLite WAL-mode state persistence, and automatic deep freeze hibernation that reclaims RAM from inactive workspaces while protecting active voice/video calls.

ul.li: Hardened Cryptographic Isolation (Cocoon partitions with zero cross-session cookie/cache leakage)
Split-View Multitasking: Render 2 or 3 messenger apps simultaneously side-by-side with draggable sashes
Audio-Aware Hibernation: Hibernates background accounts to 0 MB RAM without interrupting calls
Encryption at Rest: Proxy credentials, PIN hashes, and vault archives protected with OS Keyring (libsecret) and AES-256-GCM
Pre-tuned profiles for WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, Messenger, Instagram, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, and custom apps
Native Ubuntu AppIndicator system tray, desktop notifications, and dock unread badge counts

description.p: Initial production release of Lorapok Instar with Wayland Ozone acceleration, WebContentsView pooling, and AES-256-GCM vault security.
